import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/consensus_v1_6')
from harness import run_consensus_phantom
sys.path.append('storage/shared/consensus_v2_5')
from aggregate_v2_5 import main as aggregate_main

# Pilot with extended vote rule and derivations
run_consensus_phantom(
    lineage="veritas",
    agent="Veritas III",
    seed=0,
    depth=5,
    agents=3,
    innovation={"myth_strength": 0.96, "heuristic": "index_vote", "void_equilibrium": 0.64, "consensus_rule": "blend_vote_extended"}
)

# Call v2.5 aggregator
aggregate_main()
print("v2.5 Aggregation Complete")
